regime_context: The absolute-trend gate is validated on this market (gate_helps true), so trend discipline has real risk-control value, but cross-sectional momentum rank-IC is ~0 and rotation timing has no edge. The field is broad and non-dominant (tradable breadth 39%, one_narrative false), led by AI Infrastructure with 0.25 headline weight but fading value-state and mixed trend health. Track record shows 66% hit rate but near-coin-flip direction accuracy (0.483), so I default to low conviction on any directional call.
emerging_watch: Watching whether the trend-handoff from AI Infrastructure (durability 0.68, mixed, fading) to Cybersecurity (durability 0.85, trend, breadth 1.0) confirms via leadership margin: if Cybersecurity's score overtakes AI Infrastructure's for 5 consecutive sessions AND AI Infrastructure's breadth falls below 0.6, the handoff watch retires and Cybersecurity takes over as the confirmed leader.

theses.subject: Cybersecurity
theses.thesis: Cybersecurity is the strongest trend-health reading in the ranks: durability_bar 0.85 (highest among eligible themes), hurst_tag 'trend', and breadth 1.0 (every constituent participating). It is rank 2 and eligible under the absolute-trend gate. This is the cleanest trend-following setup among high-ranked themes, not a momentum forecast.
theses.dissent: Crowding_z is 1.8 with crowded=true — the theme is very extended in positioning terms. The detector's own guardrails say crowding has no basket-level forward edge, but it does flag an extended, potentially fragile state where a shake-out could be sharp. Direction accuracy of the note is only 0.483.

falsifier.text: CIBR fails to make a new 20-day high within 15 trading days and its breadth (share of constituents above their 50-day) drops below 0.8.

theses.subject: US Energy Complex
theses.thesis: Energy is rank 4, eligible under the absolute-trend gate, with hurst_tag 'trend', durability_bar 0.68, and breadth 0.727. It is one of only two non-tech themes in the top 6, offering a trend-eligible diversifier against the AI/tech concentration at the top of the ranks. Not crowded (0.83).
theses.dissent: The theme is rank 4 with a middling score (1.005) — leadership is not decisive, and a single macro shock to the energy complex (e.g., supply surprise) could reverse the trend. The detector has no edge on return direction.

falsifier.text: XLE gives back its 50-day moving average and breadth falls below 0.5 before 20 trading days.

theses.subject: AI Infrastructure
theses.thesis: AI Infrastructure leads the ranks (score 1.98) and is the headline theme. It is eligible and not crowded (0.59). However, its val_state is 'fading', hurst_tag 'mixed', and durability_bar only 0.68 — so I express this as a cautious trend-lean only because the absolute-trend gate passes, not as a momentum buy. This is the prevailing narrative, not a prediction.
theses.dissent: val_state 'fading' and hurst_tag 'mixed' with breadth 0.708 suggest the trend is not clean, and the guardrails explicitly warn not to treat leadership rank as a buy. The one validated edge only helps avoid drawdowns, it does not forecast continuation.

falsifier.text: SMH fails to hold above its 20-day moving average within 10 trading days and the theme's breadth falls below 0.6.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
